declarations.docstring: Transfers equivariant linear maps along an equivalence of their target Lie modules.
A Lie-module equivalence identifies the linear-map module with the tensor product of the target and the dual of the finite-dimensional source.
Establishes existence of the equivariant Hom--tensor-dual linear equivalence.
The equivariant Hom--tensor-dual equivalence for a finite-dimensional middle Lie module.
